name: Fürstenstein (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of blue charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Fürstenstein (a black wall on white under a yellow chief).
history: Municipal flag of Fürstenstein; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Fürstenstein arms — black wall on white
